name: Adams Rite Bypass
description: Adams Rite is a common latch mechanism used on aluminum storefront doors — the glass-framed commercial doors found throughout retail, office, and institutional buildings. The latch can be bypassed using a specialized hook tool or driver that manipulates the latch bolt directly through the narrow gap in the face plate. This technique is extremely common on commercial targets and any operator working corporate or retail environments should be fluent with it.

blue.det: Door alarm on state change; camera footage; aluminum storefront doors are high-risk.
blue.cm: Replace Adams Rite latches with deadlatch versions; add secondary locking; door alarms; camera coverage of storefront entry points.
